headline: England's third ODI in Hobart with the series level at 1-1 is Tuesday night, while the Grand Slam of Darts group stage ends this afternoon.
today: 2:00 PM: Grand Slam of Darts, final group games for Groups I to P, ESPN+/Hulu Live.
Tue 10:30 PM: Australia v England, 3rd ODI in Hobart, Willow.
Wed 3:00 PM: Chelsea v Paris Saint-Germain, Women's Champions League, Paramount+.

recaps.text: The Rangers beat the Canadiens 3-1 at Madison Square Garden on Monday night.
England beat Australia by 135 runs in Adelaide on Sunday to level the ODI series 1-1, with a Tom Banton century and four wickets for Gus Atkinson.

lookAhead: Saturday has England v New Zealand at 9:10 AM and Arsenal at Newcastle at 12:30 PM; the Jets visit the Chargers on Sunday at 4:05 PM.
